items.text: perhaps the most damning thing i can say about arkansas is that arch manning looks really good at football today
BYU escaped Kansas with a triple-overtime victory, but a sloppy performance could cost the No. 10 Cougars with the College Football Playoff committee, writes Gordon Monson.
Arch Manning threw for two touchdowns and ran for a score, helping No. 8 Texas beat Arkansas 45-3 on Saturday for the Longhorns' fifth consecutive win.

No. 10 BYU Beats Kansas 31-29 in Triple Overtime BYU survived a triple-overtime game against Kansas, winning 31-29 on a two-point conversion to keep its Big 12 and College Football Playoff hopes alive.
